posts.title: Welcome to Once Upon A Dice
posts.summary: We're excited to launch our new home on the web — a place for games, stories, and everything in between.
posts.body:
Welcome to the new Once Upon A Dice website! We've been hard at work building a home for our games and stories, and we're thrilled to finally share it with you.

We're Chris and Amy Allworden, a husband-wife creative team based in Central Wisconsin. Our mission is simple: to create games and stories that bring people together.

Stay tuned for updates on **Blood Moon Rising**, **Her Majesty's Airships**, and everything else we have in the works.
